title: Kaf village
description:
introductionHorror game based on true story. This game is about a guy is looking for the precious ring In the dark night village. 

You have to face ghosts to get the ring. While you explore the village, you will know some story of the previous residents.

-----------------------------

Inside the village you will see unnormal things. Don't scare and stay calm.
In the end this game is different experience. Arabic style.
description_short: ( True story gameplay ) For those who have a hard heart, they shall enter the village to search for the precious ring. During this time, you will face difficulties
